entries.note: On this Electron/macOS profile locator.dragTo emitted dragenter and dragend without a drop. Intermediate pointer movement plus repeated movement over the target lets FlexLayout's overlay receive dragover before release. Recorded DOM events and a changed pane bounding box verified the correction. Callers must assert actual placement and retained identity; surviving a drag gesture alone does not prove movement.
